# The Remnant Archive (doc 68). Plain ifs only: no else in these effects (Claude files/35).

# Precursor Lore: every gain and every price through these two (doc 66: a plain line, the variable hidden)
DA_EL_add_lore = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_lore_gain_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_EL_lore value = $amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_pay_lore = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_lore_cost_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_EL_lore value = -$amount$ } }
}
# Mana: Anbennar's own change_mana
DA_EL_pay_mana = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_mana_cost_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_mana = { amount = -$amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_pay_metal = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_metal_cost_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -$amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_add_metal = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_metal_gain_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = $amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_pay_building = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_building_cost_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -$amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_add_building = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_building_gain_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = $amount$ } }
}
DA_EL_pay_essence = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_essence_cost_tt.$amount$

# Experience in one of the mod's schools (Alchemy, Medicine, Arcane Arts)
DA_EL_add_school_exp = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_exp_tt.$school$.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_$school$_exp value = $amount$ } }
}

# The codices (doc 68, section 5.1)
DA_EL_give_codex.abjuration = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_EL_codex_gain_tt.abjuration
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# A codex not yet read, at random: only from hidden events (no dice in a button). DA_EL_new_codex.<school> names
# it for the report (DA_EL_GetNewCodex).
DA_EL_random_codex = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.abjuration
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.conjuration
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.divination
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.enchantment
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.fragment
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.evocation
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.illusion
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.necromancy
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.transmutation
	random_list = {
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration }
			DA_EL_give_codex.abjuration = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.abjuration
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.conjuration }
			DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.conjuration
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.divination }
			DA_EL_give_codex.divination = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.divination
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.enchantment }
			DA_EL_give_codex.enchantment = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.enchantment
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.fragment }
			DA_EL_give_codex.fragment = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.fragment
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.evocation }
			DA_EL_give_codex.evocation = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.evocation
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.illusion }
			DA_EL_give_codex.illusion = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.illusion
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.necromancy }
			DA_EL_give_codex.necromancy = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.necromancy
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.transmutation }
			DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_new_codex.transmutation
		}
		1 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 9 } } }
			DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 5 }
		}
	}
}

# The counts the window and the tiles read: codices, family progress, arts in practice and their upkeep.
DA_EL_refresh = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_arts_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_upkeep value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_abjuration value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj1 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_abjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj2 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_abjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj3 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_abjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj4 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_abjuration value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.abjuration }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_arts_on value = 1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_upkeep value = 0.2 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.conjuration } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_conjuration value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Con1 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_conjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Con2 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_conjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Con3 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_conjuration value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Con4 } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_conjuration value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.conjuration }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_arts_on value = 1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_upkeep value = 0.2 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.divination } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_fam_divination value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.divination }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_arts_on value = 1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_EL_upkeep value = 0.1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.enchantment } change_variable = { which = DA_EL_codices value = 1 } }

# Wyrmbane (Evocation III) against the dragon legends: the flag le_rules.ARMY_BONUS reads, while the tile is done
# and the Precursor heritage is active. From DA_EL_refresh and DA_EL_sync.
DA_EL_wyrmbane_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Evo3 DA_EL_heritage = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_wyrmbane_on } }
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_wyrmbane_on
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_wyrmbane_on NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Evo3 DA_EL_heritage = yes } } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_EL_wyrmbane_on
	}
}

# The window (elven_archive_ui.py)
DA_EL_open_archive = {
	hidden_effect = { DA_EL_refresh = yes }
	set_country_flag = DA_EL_archive_on
}
DA_EL_close_archive = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_EL_archive_on
}

# The Archive's levels (doc 68, section 7.3): the Build button of each level
DA_EL_build.1 = {
	add_treasury = -100
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_build_tt.1
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_EL_level value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_built
		if = {
			limit = { DA_RH_primary_elven = yes }
			country_event = { id = DA_EL_event.2 }
		}
		DA_EL_refresh = yes
	}
}

# Read the Fleet Logs (elves) and Raise a Dotim Pole (Ruinborn): one codex each time, in order
DA_EL_logs = {
	add_treasury = -50
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.abjuration = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.divination }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.divination = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.enchantment }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.enchantment = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_given DA_EL_refresh = yes }
}
DA_EL_poles = {
	add_treasury = -50
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.conjuration }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.necromancy }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.necromancy = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.transmutation }
		}
		DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_given }
	}
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_given DA_EL_refresh = yes }
}
DA_EL_study = {
	DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 3 }
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.study set_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.study }
}

# The running research advances: by a share of its target, or of what remains
DA_EL_research_percent = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent which = DA_research_progress }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent value = 100 }
}
DA_EL_push_target = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_dp which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_EL_dp value = $pct$ }
	change_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_EL_dp }
	DA_EL_research_percent = yes
}
DA_EL_push_remaining = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_EL_dp which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_EL_dp which = DA_research_progress }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_EL_dp value = $pct$ }
	change_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_EL_dp }
	DA_EL_research_percent = yes
}

	add_treasury = -300

		limit = { NOT = { DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes } }

	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_EL_commune_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.commune set_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.commune country_event = { id = DA_EL_event.3 } }

# The arts (doc 68, section 8): privileges of the Archaeomancers, granted and revoked only here
DA_EL_art_granted = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.$s$
		DA_EL_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_EL_art_removed = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.$s$ }
			clr_country_flag = DA_EL_aside.$s$
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_aside.$s$
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.$s$
		DA_EL_refresh = yes
	}
}

# The yearly pass: while the month's mana is below 0, the dearest arts are set aside (doc 68, section 8.2, rule 5)
DA_EL_shortfall = {
	update_mana_regen_vars = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = mages_mana_regen_val value = 0 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_EL_m which = mages_mana_regen_val }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.fragment
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_fragment
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.3 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.fragment
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.necromancy
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_necromancy
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.3 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.necromancy
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.abjuration
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_abjuration
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.abjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.conjuration
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_conjuration
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.conjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.evocation
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_evocation
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.evocation
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.illusion
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_illusion
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.illusion
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.transmutation
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_transmutation
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.transmutation
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.divination
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_divination
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.1 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.divination
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0 } }
				has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.enchantment
			}
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_enchantment
			change_variable = { which = DA_EL_m value = 0.1 }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_short.enchantment
		}
		country_event = { id = DA_EL_event.5 }
	}
}

# Monthly: the works and marvels being raised (DA_EL_raising)
DA_EL_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_raising }
		clr_country_flag = DA_EL_raising
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { OR = { has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising has_province_flag = DA_EL_ws_raising has_province_flag = DA_EL_sp_raising } }
			owner = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_raising }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 945 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			945 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.81 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 1068 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			1068 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.82 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 2497 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			2497 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.83 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 2112 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			2112 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.84 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 2745 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			2745 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.85 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 2201 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_EL_mv_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_mv_timer } } }
			2201 = { province_event = { id = DA_EL_event.86 } }
		}
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_EL_ws_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_works_timer } }
			clr_province_flag = DA_EL_ws_raising
			set_province_flag = DA_EL_ws
			add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_EL_wardstone duration = -1 }
		}
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_EL_sp_raising NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_EL_works_timer } }
			clr_province_flag = DA_EL_sp_raising
			set_province_flag = DA_EL_sp
			add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_EL_spire duration = -1 }
		}
	}
}
# Yearly, for a country of the heritage with the Archive built
DA_EL_yearly = {
	DA_EL_refresh = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ai = no has_country_flag = DA_EL_estate }
		DA_EL_shortfall = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Nec2 }
		DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 2745 = { owned_by = ROOT check_variable = { which = DA_EL_mv value = 1 } } }
		DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_ruled.stacks_keep }
			DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			2201 = { owned_by = ROOT check_variable = { which = DA_EL_mv value = 1 } }
			OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_lab_cd } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_EL_lab_cd days = 1825 } }
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_EL_lab_cd
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_lab_cd
		DA_EL_add_school_exp = { school = Alchemy amount = 200 }
		if = {
			limit = { 2201 = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_mv value = 2 } } }
			DA_EL_add_essence = { amount = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 2201 = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_mv value = 3 } } }
			DA_EL_add_school_exp = { school = Medicine amount = 200 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_ruled.lab_grow }
			DA_EL_add_essence = { amount = 10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_veil_war NOT = { is_at_war = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_EL_veil_war
	}
}
# The heritage turns dormant: every art is set aside (their privileges are no longer valid). Racial pulse hook.
DA_EL_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.abjuration }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_abjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.conjuration }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_conjuration
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.divination }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_divination
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.enchantment }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_enchantment
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.fragment }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_fragment
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.evocation }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_evocation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.illusion }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_illusion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.necromancy }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_necromancy
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_art_on.transmutation }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_EL_art_transmutation
		}
	}
	DA_EL_wyrmbane_sync = yes	# DA_EL: Wyrmbane in the Legendary Encounters (doc 72)
}

# The AI (doc 68, section 14): its codices once, then the next tile of the Elven page (from DA_RH_ai_pulse)
DA_EL_ai_init = {
	set_country_flag = DA_EL_ai_init
	if = {
		limit = { DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes }
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.conjuration
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.necromancy
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.transmutation
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes } }
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.abjuration
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.divination
		set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.enchantment
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { primary_culture = sun_elf primary_culture = sunrise_elf primary_culture = sunset_elf primary_culture = desert_elf } }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.evocation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { primary_culture = wood_elf } }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.illusion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { primary_culture = dawn_elf primary_culture = horizon_elf primary_culture = sea_elf } }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.transmutation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { OR = { primary_culture = dawn_elf primary_culture = desert_elf primary_culture = horizon_elf primary_culture = sea_elf primary_culture = sun_elf primary_culture = sunrise_elf primary_culture = sunset_elf primary_culture = wood_elf } } }
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_codex.illusion
		}
	}
	DA_EL_refresh = yes
}
DA_EL_ai_act = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_ai_init } }
		DA_EL_ai_init = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj1 }
			DA_EL_codex_read.abjuration = yes
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_EL_Abj1
			time = 48
			arcane = yes
			unstoppable = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj2 }
			DA_PR_done.EL_Abj1 = yes
			DA_completed.Magic_Theory_2 = yes
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_EL_Abj2
			time = 72
			arcane = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj3 }
			DA_PR_done.EL_Abj2 = yes
			DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_EL_Abj3
			time = 72
			steam = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Abj4 }
			DA_PR_done.EL_Abj3 = yes
			DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes
			DA_EL_ring.6 = yes
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_EL_Abj4
			time = 96
			electric = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Con1 }
			DA_EL_codex_read.conjuration = yes
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_EL_Con1
			time = 72
			arcane = yes
			unstoppable = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
